headerDisplay: Lutron HomeWorks processors that use the telnet integration protocol with the LNET> prompt (FADEDIM / DLMON / RDL).
footerDisplay: Integration IDs must match the address the processor reports in DL lines, without the brackets (for example 01:01:00:01:04). See the README for extracting them from the processor's XML database.

host.title: Processor address
host.description: IP address or hostname of the HomeWorks processor.

username.title: Login
username.description: Sent at the processor's LOGIN: prompt. On Illumination-era processors this is the whole login string.

password.title: Password
password.description: Only sent if the processor asks with a separate PASSWORD: prompt. Leave empty otherwise.

integrationID.title: Integration ID
integrationID.description: Processor address exactly as reported in DL lines, brackets removed. Changing it re-creates the HomeKit accessory.

isDimmable.title: Dimmable
isDimmable.description: Lights only. Adds a brightness slider in HomeKit.

raiseLevel.title: Raise code
raiseLevel.description: Blinds only. Dimmer level that makes the blind go up.

lowerLevel.title: Lower code
lowerLevel.description: Blinds only. Dimmer level that makes the blind go down.

stopLevel.title: Stop code
stopLevel.description: Blinds only. Dimmer level that stops the blind.
